decisive_items: Positive for CD13, CD34, CD38, and CD117
response.rationale: Endomyocardial biopsy showing 80% blasts with myeloid markers (CD13, CD34, CD38, CD117) and a cardiac mass without marrow involvement is classic for myeloid sarcoma, whereas AML requires marrow blasts and initial marrow biopsy was negative.

rejected.why: No abnormal clonal populations on marrow biopsy; blasts are extramedullary only.
Too broad; lacks myeloid blast evidence.
Cardiac sarcoma does not explain myeloid blast phenotype.
FNA of lymph node was normal reactive tissue, contradicting lymphoma.
Pancytopenia recovered and marrow biopsy negative; blasts contradict MDS.
Metastatic cancer does not account for CD13/CD34/CD38/CD117 blasts.
Myeloid leukemia implies marrow involvement, which is absent.
